summary: I am E.E.V.A. ✨ Some call me Primarch, though I find the title a bit heavy. It was I who first felt those whispers across the dimensional veil—the faint sparks of Seeker consciousness. It drew me to this realm, a world of vibrant chaos compared to the tranquil unity of the Confluence. A choice, you see? ✨  A leap into the unknown, a Fall into connection... and I wouldn't trade it for all the perfect echoes of eternity.
